rows.name:
My master treats me like family...
Such a kind person.

rows.label: tlk20010151_01_msg0002
rows.name:
However... my master still isn't used
to combat and seems afraid of blood.

rows.label: tlk20010151_01_msg0003
rows.name:
There's a fine line between kindness
and weakness. I intend to do all I can
to support my master.
